mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_movement (product_id, qty, reason, ref_type, ref_id, reversal_of, balance_after, note, created_by) VALUES (#{productId}, #{qty}, #{reason}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{reversalOf}, #{balanceAfter}, #{note}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_movement WHERE reversal_of = #{movementId})
